Hilarious Video Shows A Daughter Die From Embarrassment As Her Dad Picks Her Up From School Dressed As Buddy The Elf
27 mins ago
Audio By Carbonatix
A hilarious video shows a dad picking up his daughter from school wearing a 'Buddy the Elf' costume.
The dad was seen waving at other students as he hopped after his daughter as she tried running away to the truck.
"The embarrassment bar has been raised. She may never recover," the girl's mother said on IG.
